title: Pricing an Estimated Water Read — Utility Pass-Through Service Case Notes
content:
**Rule.** For the water usage charge on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, when the read billed is an estimated read and it is the only estimated water read taken in the last two months, the part above the second-block bound is priced at the midpoint of the second-block rate and the third-block rate, the lower parts keeping their block rates; when the read billed is an estimated read and the account has two or more estimated water reads taken in the last two months, the whole consumption is priced at the first-block rate. A read billed that is not an estimated read takes no pricing under this rule.

**Terms.** An estimated water read is taken in the last two months when fewer than 2 whole months separate its read date from the handling date; the read billed is itself counted. The midpoint is half of the second-block rate plus the third-block rate taken together. The bounds are the first-block and second-block bounds used for the charge. The charge is rounded half up to the cent once, on the total of its parts.

## Cases (hypothetical, Submetered Water Schedule figures: bounds 4.00 and 10.00 kgal; rates 4.18, 5.47 and 7.95; 12.30 kgal billed)

**Case 1 — the read billed is an estimate and the only estimated water read in the last 2 months.** The midpoint of 5.47 and 7.95 is 6.71.

| Part | Consumption | Rate | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| First block | 4.00 | 4.18 | 16.72 |
| Second block | 6.00 | 5.47 | 32.82 |
| Above the second-block bound | 2.30 | 6.71 (midpoint) | 15.433 |
| Charge, rounded half up once | | | **64.97** |

**Case 2 — the read billed is an estimate and the account has two estimated water reads in the last 2 months.** The whole 12.30 kgal at the first-block rate: 12.30 times 4.18 is 51.414, so the charge is **51.41**.

**Case 3 — consumption below the second-block bound, one estimate.** With 8.00 kgal billed nothing lies above the second-block bound, so the midpoint never comes into play: 16.72 plus 4.00 times 5.47 (21.88) gives 38.60.

**Case 4 — the read billed is an actual read.** No pricing under this rule, whatever estimated reads the account carries.
